A modest readable line chart called “回款趋势”, interval labels 09/26,10/02,10/08,10/14,10/20,10/25, y-axis unit “万元”, a positive gently fluctuating receipt trend. Relevant business chart, not decorative artwork.

Keep the same above business content, numbers and clear functions. Use a left sidebar, header and four-metric row; arrange chart, pending actions and table below with coherent hierarchy. Fit complete useful content within the frame without tiny illegible text. Do not invent extra business modules or data.

Design direction A — apply the following Deityki personal UI specification, which is the variable under examination:
- Restrained task-first shadcn/ui Nova design language. Quiet, precise, refined enterprise UI. Prioritize task information and useful table density, not dashboard decoration.
- Exact Radix Colors light palette direction, use ONLY this coordinated UI color set: slate1 #fcfcfd app background, slate2 #f9f9fb sidebar or subtle surfaces, slate3 #f0f0f3 selected neutral areas, slate6 #d9d9de subtle hairlines, slate7 #cdced6 interactive borders, slate11 #60646c secondary text, slate12 #1c2024 main text; indigo3 #edf2fe selected accent background, indigo9 #3e63dd primary action and chart line, indigo11 #3a5bc7 accent text; green3 #e6f6eb and green11 #218358 for success; amber3 #fff7c2 and amber11 #ab6400 for attention. Restrict stronger accent to meaningful actions and states. No rainbow stats.
- Only three typography sizes, nominal 14px all body/navigation/labels, 18px section headings, 28px metric values; hierarchy via weight, whitespace and semantic color. Chinese body is clear and comfortably legible. No microprint.
- Concise necessary copy only, no greeting banner, no descriptive subtitle under headings, no decorative English eyebrows, no redundant secondary labels, no invented slogan, no dot separators.
- Summary metrics in one calm open aligned strip or single shared surface, with subtle separators instead of four independently floating decorative cards.
- Optical alignment of icons/text, shared left edges and baselines, clean 8px spacing rhythm, generous but productive whitespace. Meticulous column alignment, right-align numbers where useful.
- Subtle nominal 0.5px border hairlines. Modest functional corner radii on controls and meaningful containers only; nested inner radii relate to padding for concentric visual curves. Avoid enclosing every section in a card. No heavy shadow, no glass, no gradients, no colored left border on cards.
- Consistent thin Lucide-style UI line icons, no emoji. Small restrained status pills or inline status, no oversized badges.
- Clear primary “创建项目” button, secondary “导出报表”; make pending work easy to spot without oversized hero decorations. Include a subtle selected navigation state. Make the whole UI feel composed, coherent and ready for real use.
